symptom: Agent-editor catalog rows mark 'absent' two ways: an absent reference (Model, Entity, Endpoint, AuthenticationMicroflow, KeyConstant, Document) is '' while an absent optional value (SelectedModel, DisplayTitle, streaming switches) is NULL, sometimes in one row (RefundAgent|Task||∅), so 'no endpoint' was Endpoint = '' but 'no selected model' was SelectedModel IS NULL
cause: docRefName / constantRefName returned string and so could only say '' for a nil reference, while the optional-value helpers returned any and passed nil through
insight: A helper's Go return type decides the column's absence convention: a string-returning ref helper cannot produce NULL. Return any and pass nil. Before flipping a column from '' to NULL, grep every consumer (.star lint rules, Go Scan into string, skills, docs) for `= ''` and for Scan targets that cannot take NULL; for the agent tables the only consumers were the views, one test and catalog-tables.md. Bump CatalogSchemaVersion or a cached catalog keeps '' and IS NULL finds nothing. The wider catalog (QueueRef, widget refs, ParentLoopId) still uses '' and is documented and queried that way by lint rules, so changing it needs its own ADR-scale change, not a drive-by.
